country.name: Belize
country.languagePolicy: English is the default interface language. Belize Kriol, Spanish, Garifuna, Maya languages and other community language needs require locally reviewed access; automatic translation is not treated as reviewed educational localization.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Belizean reviewer, a current authoritative source and confirmation of the responsible ministry, district, managing authority or institution.

governanceModel.summary: Belize combines MoECST national and district administration with government, government-aided, community and private managing authorities. MoECST licenses tertiary institutions, while external quality assurance and the National Accreditation Council must be represented according to their actual operational status.
governanceModel.nationalAuthority: Ministry of Education, Culture, Science and Technology (MoECST)
governanceModel.districtAndManagementRule: Record the responsible District Education Centre and school managing authority where applicable.
governanceModel.tertiaryRule: Legal permission to operate, institutional recognition and accreditation are distinct and must never be merged into one claim.

authorities.name: Ministry of Education, Culture, Science and Technology
authorities.role: national education authority, licensing, school services, curriculum and statistics

authorities.name: Policy, Planning, Research and Evaluation Unit
National Accreditation Council of Belize
authorities.role: developing national tertiary quality-assurance and accreditation institution

authorities.name: Data Protection Commissioner framework
authorities.role: authority created by the Data Protection Act 2021; commencement and appointment status require current legal verification

curriculum.authority: Ministry of Education, Culture, Science and Technology
curriculum.title: National Curriculum Framework and competency-based curriculum transformation
curriculum.implementationRule: Confirm the current framework, learning outcomes, level, pilot or implementation phase, school calendar and applicable district or managing-authority guidance.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: 501 Academy and external materials may support teaching but do not silently replace controlling curriculum requirements.

schoolDirectory.authority: Ministry of Education, Culture, Science and Technology
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: MoECST publishes directories by level and year. BRASA must display directory level and publication date, check for a newer source, and must not infer current operation or every program from an older listing.

educationStatistics.authority: Policy, Planning, Research and Evaluation Unit, MoECST
educationStatistics.scopeNotice: Every figure must display school year, publication title, definition and review date; figures from one year must not be presented as current without qualification.

higherEducation.licensingAuthority: Ministry of Education, Culture, Science and Technology
higherEducation.authorityNotice: MoECST licensing or an institutional listing is not itself proof of external accreditation. Any NACB accreditation claim requires a current official decision for the named institution or program.

privacyAndSafeguarding.commencementNotice: The Act is enacted, but commencement and the current appointment or operation of its institutions must be verified from current official notices before a compliance claim is made.
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Data protection, child welfare, consent, safeguarding and incident procedures require current legal and institutional review before real learner participation.

completionCriteria: A qualified Belizean education reviewer is named.
MoECST, district and managing-authority boundaries are reviewed.
Every school record identifies directory level, source year, publication date and management type.
Every statistic identifies school year, definition, publication and provenance.
Every tertiary institution record separates permission to operate from external accreditation.
NACB operational and decision status is verified from a current official source before any accreditation claim.
Curriculum mappings identify level and current implementation or pilot status.
Belize Kriol, Spanish, Garifuna and Maya language needs are reviewed with competent local participation.
Data Protection Act commencement and enforcement arrangements are reviewed by qualified Belizean counsel.
Privacy, child protection, accessibility, incident and consent procedures are approved by the participating institution.
No authorization, accreditation, partnership or credential claim exceeds documentary evidence.
